evals.name: baseline-no-override
evals.expected_output: Markdown standup report for the invoking GitHub user (name from the users API), with sections What I did, In flight and, where data exists, Next up and Needs an owner. In flight combines open PRs, active board items (only when the repo has a board) and pushed branches with commits in the window and no PR. Nothing is posted to Slack.

evals.name: with-next-override-freeform
evals.prompt: /daily-update I'm planning to work on the retry-loop fix today
evals.expected_output: Same report shape, but Next up says 'Per your input:' and quotes the override text verbatim instead of suggesting a board item.

evals.name: natural-language-trigger
evals.prompt: give me my standup — what did I do yesterday and what should I work on next?
evals.expected_output: Same report shape as baseline. Tests that the natural-language phrasing in the description triggers the skill without the slash command.

evals.name: slack-only-when-asked-no-default-channel
evals.prompt: give me my standup and post it to slack
evals.expected_output: The report is rendered first. No channel was named, so the skill uses the slack-channel from .agents/skill-config/daily-update.md if present, otherwise asks which channel. It never invents a default channel, shows the preview and channel and waits for approval before sending.
